shortDescription: Australia’s residential property market remained subdued as auction clearance rates fell this week amid growing concern that the central bank will raise interest rates later this month, according to Bloomberg reported Cotality.

title: Australia Auction Clearance Rates Fall on Rate-Hike Fears
